note: Dataset revisions consumed by scripts/download_datasets.sh. The top-level repository holds the frozen evaluation conditions (eval/db_conditions/ and eval/db_h3_inputs/), which --eval-conditions installs. multitask names the training release, which --repo-id selects, and the multitask set's path in it. Explicit --revision or DEXBENCH_DATA_REVISION overrides the pin.
